sections.heading: Zakat & Financial Assistance
body: Hijaz Hospital is committed to ensuring that financial hardship does not prevent deserving patients from receiving essential medical care. Through its Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System and charitable welfare programs, the hospital provides financial assistance to eligible patients with fairness, dignity, and compassion.

sections.heading: Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System
body: Hijaz Hospital has established a Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System (ZMS) under the supervision of qualified Islamic scholars and respected Muftis. The system ensures that Zakat donations are received, managed, and utilized strictly in accordance with the teachings of the Qur'an and Sunnah.

All Zakat contributions are maintained in a dedicated account separate from other hospital funds. Patient eligibility is assessed by the Welfare Shariah Department, where each case is reviewed with complete confidentiality and respect for the patient's dignity.

Eligible patients receive financial assistance for their medical treatment through the Zakat fund. Patients who do not meet the prescribed Shariah criteria may still be considered for assistance through general donations or other charitable welfare resources. (Other than zakat and Sadqate-e-Wajiba)

The system is supervised by the hospital's Shariah consultant in consultation with a three-member Shariah Committee, ensuring that all policies and procedures remain fully aligned with established Shariah principles.

sections.heading: Financial Assistance for Deserving Patients
body: Hijaz Hospital provides financial assistance to patients who are unable to afford medical treatment. Depending on eligibility, support may be provided through Zakat and Sadqat-e-Wajiba funds and general donations.
Each application is assessed individually based on the patient's financial circumstances (Income, Assets and Liability), medical needs, and the availability of assistance.

sections.heading: Eligibility & Application Process
sections.intro: Patients seeking financial assistance may contact the Welfare Shariah Department for guidance. Applications are processed through a structured and confidential assessment that includes:

steps.title: Submission of an application for financial assistance.
Assessment of the patient's financial circumstances and medical requirements.
Review by the Welfare Department and, where applicable, the Welfare Shariah Department.
Approval in accordance with the applicable welfare or Zakat criteria.

body: Hijaz Hospital remains committed to serving the community with compassion, integrity, and responsible stewardship, ensuring that deserving patients receive essential medical care while donors can contribute with confidence.

sections.heading: Patient Admission Process
sections.intro: Hijaz Hospital follows a structured admission process to ensure smooth coordination, timely treatment, and quality patient care.

steps.title: OPD Consultation & Assessment
items: Patients visit the OPD Registration Counter for registration and consultation.
A department-wise token is issued, and the patient meets the relevant consultant.
The consultant evaluates the patient and determines whether admission is required.

steps.title: Admission & Eligibility Verification
items: If admission is advised, the patient proceeds to the relevant admission desk for further processing.
For patients to be registered under the Sehat Sahulat Program (SSP), eligibility verification and required approvals are completed through the SSP system.
Necessary admission documentation is completed, and the patient file is prepared.

steps.title: Pre-Procedure Assessment (If Required)
items: Patients requiring surgery or procedures undergo assessment by the Anesthesia Department.
The anesthesia consultant evaluates the patient's fitness for the planned procedure.

steps.title: Financial Assistance & Category Assessment
items: Patient category and financial arrangements are confirmed according to hospital policy.
Eligible patients may receive assistance through the applicable support programs, including welfare and financial assistance services.

steps.title: Admission & Treatment
items: After completion of admission formalities, the patient is shifted to the relevant ward.
Treatment, surgery, or medical management is provided according to the consultant's advice.
During the hospital stay, patient care, medicines, investigations, and treatment records are managed through the inpatient care system.

steps.title: Discharge Process
items: After completion of treatment, the final bill and discharge documentation are prepared.
The patient receives a discharge summary and necessary instructions before leaving the hospital.

sections.heading: Patient Rights & Responsibilities
body: Hijaz Hospital is committed to protecting the rights, dignity, and well-being of every patient. Quality healthcare is achieved through mutual respect, cooperation, and partnership between patients, attendants, and healthcare teams. All patients are entitled to receive safe, respectful, and compassionate care while also contributing to a positive healthcare environment.

items.title: Right to Respect & Dignity
items.content: Every patient has the right to be treated with respect, compassion, and dignity regardless of religion, gender, age, or financial status.

items.title: Right to Quality Healthcare
items.content: Patients have the right to receive safe, appropriate, and professional medical care according to established hospital standards.

items.title: Right to Privacy & Confidentiality
items.content: Patients have the right to privacy. All personal information, medical records, and treatment details are kept confidential.

items.title: Right to Information
items.content: Patients have the right to receive clear information regarding:
bullets: Possible risks, benefits, and available treatment options

items.title: Right to Informed Consent
items.content: Patients and, where applicable, their attendants have the right to receive information and provide consent before major procedures or surgeries, except in emergency situations where immediate care is required.

items.title: Right to Emergency Care
items.content: Patients have the right to receive emergency medical care without unnecessary delay.

items.title: Right to Respectful Communication
items.content: Patients have the right to ask questions regarding their treatment and receive understandable explanations from healthcare providers.

items.title: Right to Second Opinion
items.content: Patients have the right to seek a second medical opinion from another qualified healthcare professional when required.

items.title: Right to Complaint & Feedback
items.content: Patients have the right to share complaints, concerns, or suggestions without fear of discrimination or unfair treatment.

items.title: Right to Financial Transparency
items.content: Patients have the right to receive clear information regarding treatment costs, billing details, and available welfare or financial assistance options where applicable.

items.title: Provide Accurate Information
items.content: Patients and attendants should provide complete and accurate information regarding medical history, current medications, allergies, and personal details necessary for proper care.

items.title: Follow Medical Advice
items.content: Patients should follow treatment plans, medication instructions, and guidance provided by doctors and healthcare professionals.

items.title: Respect Hospital Staff
items.content: Patients and attendants should treat doctors, nurses, and hospital staff with respect and cooperate throughout the treatment process.

items.title: Follow Hospital Rules & Guidelines
items.content: Patients and attendants should follow hospital policies, including:

items.title: Protect Hospital Property
items.content: Patients and attendants should use hospital facilities, equipment, and resources responsibly.

items.title: Fulfill Financial Responsibilities
items.content: Patients should complete necessary financial requirements related to their care or contact the relevant welfare department if financial assistance is required.

items.title: Support Infection Prevention Measures
items.content: Patients and visitors should follow hygiene instructions and infection control guidelines to help maintain a safe environment for everyone.

items.title: Maintain a Respectful Environment
items.content: Violence, aggressive behavior, smoking, or misuse of hospital premises is not permitted.

items.title: Attend Follow-Up Visits
items.content: Patients should attend scheduled follow-up appointments, investigations, and consultations as advised by healthcare providers.

items.title: Cooperate in the Care Process
items.content: Patients and attendants should cooperate with healthcare teams and provide necessary support to ensure safe and effective treatment outcomes.

sections.heading: Flood Relief & Humanitarian Assistance
body: Hijaz Hospital has always remained committed to supporting communities during times of hardship and natural disasters. During the floods of 2005, 2011, and 2022, the hospital extended support to affected communities across Punjab and other regions of Pakistan.

The relief efforts included the construction of more than 50 houses for flood-affected families during the 2022 floods, contributions toward the construction of mosques and other community support initiatives, and financial assistance for families facing challenges due to flood-related losses.

Hijaz Hospital believes that its commitment to humanity extends beyond healthcare services. In times of need, the hospital continues to support affected communities with compassion, dignity, and a spirit of service.

sections.heading: Dialysis Patient Support Program
body: Patients living with kidney failure often require lifelong dialysis treatment, placing significant financial and emotional strain on both patients and their families. Recognizing these challenges, Hijaz Hospital provides dedicated support to deserving dialysis patients through its welfare programs.

At Hijaz Hospital, dialysis patients are given special care and support because they often face long-term illness and remain dependent on dialysis treatment for survival. Due to the continuous nature of this disease, many patients are unable to work and face serious financial difficulties.

In addition to subsidized or free dialysis treatment for eligible patients, the hospital offers financial assistance to help ease the burden of long-term care. Keeping this hardship in view, Hijaz Hospital provides special financial assistance to deserving dialysis patients.

sections.heading: Depending on individual circumstances, support may include

items.text: Assistance during exceptional personal or financial hardship
Support for essential family needs, including marriage assistance in deserving cases

body: Hijaz Hospital also extends support to dialysis patients in important family matters, including assistance for the marriage of their daughters where needed. Through this program, Hijaz Hospital extends its care beyond medical treatment by supporting the overall well-being of dialysis patients and their families with compassion, dignity, and respect.
This initiative reflects the hospital's commitment to standing alongside deserving patients throughout their treatment journey and helping them maintain a better quality of life.

sections.heading: Free Medicines for Eligible Patients
body: At Hijaz Hospital, serving humanity with compassion and dignity is our core mission. The hospital provides 100% free medicines to OPD patients, especially those who are deserving and unable to bear the cost of treatment.

Hijaz Hospital provides prescribed medicines free of charge to eligible outpatient (OPD) patients. Through its Pharmacy Department, the hospital ensures that patients can continue their treatment without the burden of medicine costs.

sections.heading: Available Across Key Clinical Departments
intro: This support is available across key clinical departments, including:

millions of rupees in medicines provided free of cost

body: From 2021 to 2025, medicines worth millions of rupees have been provided free of cost to patients. In 2025 alone, Hijaz Hospital provided free medicines amounting to approximately Rs. 174 million across these departments.

With the generous support of donors, Hijaz Hospital continues to provide free medicines worth millions of rupees each year to patients in need. This initiative reflects the hospital's commitment to making essential healthcare more accessible and ensuring continuity of treatment for deserving patients.

sections.heading: Free Meals for Patients and Attendants
body: At Hijaz Hospital, we believe that patient care extends beyond medical treatment. As part of our commitment to compassion and community service, the hospital provides three nutritious meals daily to admitted patients and their attendants.

This service helps reduce the financial burden on families, allowing them to focus on treatment, recovery, and the well-being of their loved ones. By providing meals with dignity and care, Hijaz Hospital continues its mission of supporting patients and their families throughout their healthcare journey.

sections.heading: Three Nutritious Meals Every Day
intro: Meals are provided with dignity and care to admitted patients and their attendants throughout their hospital stay.

sections.heading: Sehat Sahulat Program
body: Hijaz Hospital facilitates eligible patients through the Sehat Sahulat Program, a government-supported healthcare initiative designed to improve access to medical treatment for citizens of Pakistan.

Through this program, eligible patients can receive healthcare services while reducing the financial burden of medical expenses. Hijaz Hospital remains committed to supporting quality, affordable, and patient-centered healthcare for the community.

sections.heading: Patient Information Guide
body: At Hijaz Hospital, we are committed to providing compassionate, safe, and quality healthcare services for every patient and family. This Patient Information Guide has been prepared to help you understand hospital services, patient rights, safety measures, and your journey of care.

sections.heading: Request an Appointment
body: The Request an Appointment facility at Hijaz Hospital is available for private, protocol, and general patients. Patients can book an appointment with the relevant consultant for timely consultation, proper guidance, and quality medical care.

sections.heading: Online Reports Facility
body: At Hijaz Hospital, patients can conveniently view their lab reports, ultrasound findings, and X-ray reports online through the hospital's website and mobile application.
This facility allows patients to access their reports anytime on their mobile phones, making the process more convenient and reducing waiting time at the hospital.

sections.heading: Patient Success Stories
body: Hijaz Hospital proudly shares department-wise patient success stories in detail through our official social media platforms. These stories reflect the impact of our free and compassionate healthcare services, the dedication of our medical teams, and the trust of our valued donors.
Patients and donors can visit our social media links to explore real stories of hope, recovery, and service to humanity.
